evidence.title: How avatarin built a 24/7 retail agent with GPT-Realtime

summary: Avatarin has developed a round-the-clock AI retail assistant powered by GPT-Realtime, enhancing customer service automation. The system leverages real-time conversational AI to handle inquiries and transactions continuously.
title: Avatarin Deploys 24/7 AI Retail Agent Using GPT-Realtime
